data.name: Board Game Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Step into a true-to-life board game simulator designed to faithfully recreate the tactile and strategic experience of your favorite tabletop games. Currently featuring a full implementation of Five Tribes, this platform goes beyond rules and mechanics by visually mimicking the actual game components — for example, using coin tokens to represent currency just like in the physical game.

This simulator aims to provide an immersive, authentic feel as if you’re playing on a real table, preserving the charm and nuances that make each board game special. With plans to expand into a broad library of titles, this is your gateway to classic and modern board games digitally—played solo, locally, or online.
Key Features

  • Authentic physical gameplay: Every element mirrors the real board game, including coin tokens, cards, and pieces for a tactile feel.

  • Complete Five Tribes experience: All rules and components carefully implemented to match the original game.

  • Growing board game library: Designed to add more titles while keeping that authentic tabletop vibe.

  • Flexible multiplayer: Supports local and online play with friends.

  • Intuitive and visually rich UI: Clear, elegant design to enhance the feel of a real tabletop session.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 and 1GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
